model.line: 3 boxes stand in this compound, 3 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 北远山村: 乾隆七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆七年 (1742), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.251 item (1), under 北远山村
evidence.excerpt_zh: 亭皋淡寒林，坂原余残菊。山村学溪荘，竹篱围茅屋。欲验农功勤，时寓几余目。值此三冬初，乐彼五糓熟。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 北远山村, 1742. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 北远山村: 乾隆八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆八年 (1743), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.252 item (3), under 北远山村
evidence.excerpt_zh: 苇㟁沙汀曲复斜，溪村一棹玩清嘉。田间野老骑秧马，术上牯牛转水车。试舞鹤雏双羽襹，学讴牧竖数声哑。迎眸好景披图画，何异游仙泛若耶。”“西山凝黛望中遥，时有轻云出岫飘。润逼林皋当首夏，甘流泉乳想余姚。苏轼诗。 （余姚古县亦何有龙井白泉甘胜乳）连天树色清依槛，得雨溪声涨到桥。寄语方壶员峤客，好携烟侣共呼招。烟容水态罨篷窗，无恙轻风挂竹䉶。出埭玉勹纔个个，掠空沙燕故双双。僧归野寺闲行杖，人过山村远吠尨。日暮西峰飞雨脚，拟听彻夜乱珠摐。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 北远山村, 1743, on boating. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 北远山村: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
evidence.date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.252 item (11), under 北远山村
evidence.excerpt_zh: 今晨更喜十分晴，放棹平湖万象清。几转碧溪最深处，田家风景系予情。日午停桡曲涧滨，高低文石势嶙峋。试登层阁舒遐瞩，廑念畿南失业民。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 北远山村, 1823, on boating. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 贾珺 on 北远山村 龙王庙, later 观音庵
evidence.summary: North-west of 北远山村: octagonal pyramid-roof hall with a one-bay south porch, built 1733 for Yongzheng's tablet of the rain god, from 1734 a dragon-king temple, later 观音庵, date unknown. The plan's 观音庵 is a round building on a mound just inside the north gate, about 55 m from the listed centre of YM26 (own calculation): it fits form, place and name. S47 fig.7 shows it.

evidence.title: 北门内 水关 小庙 (S47 section 2.7)
evidence.summary: Orders of 1733-34 speak of a rain-god shrine at the rushing water north-west of 北苑山房 inside 北门, and of 北门内水关之河北小庙: so a water gate stood just inside the north gate by then.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 北远山村
evidence.locator: from p.251, under 北远山村
evidence.summary: The compiler describes a water gate at the south-east with Qianlong's stone plaque, low farm courts with mulberries for silkworms, and 课农轩, rebuilt in 1817 as a five-bay, two-roll hall with a front annex, with 观音庵 to the west. 北远山村: 11 dated items, 1742-1823, of which 11 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing, Daoguang); recurring themes: boating, the view, the harvest. First dated 1742, last dated 1823.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 北远山村
evidence.summary: A village scene from late Yongzheng, the garden's silk-farming quarter from 1729. Five-bay 课农轩 with a three-bay annex was built in 1817 on the sites of 皆春阁, 稻凉楼, 涉趣楼 and 湛虚书屋. West of it the octagonal 观音庵, once a dragon-king temple; also 水村图, 绘雨精舍, 兰野, 观澜亭. Some survived 1860 under guard.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
